fact: A 31 March 2026 report finds that during Uganda's 2026 elections AI-enabled deepfakes and synthetic messaging went uncontained while data protection law was enforced selectively, against individual civic actors rather than the Electoral Commission, which registered with the PDPO only on 21 January 2026.
title: Uneven Enforcement of Data Protection Laws Puts Data Subjects Rights at Risk in Uganda's 2026 Polls
